page.overview:
Who is Coswald?

was a green dragonborn prisoner in the Calamity-era prison at Rybad-Kol when it was destroyed in a battle between the gods. As an NPC, was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Coswald was a brawny green dragonborn with an exceptionally long and draconic neck.

At some point in his past Coswald was caught stealing and sent as a prisoner to Rybad-Kol.

Coswald was part of a caravan of dragonborn being assembled at the prison to be sent to The Scaled Tyrant, either to fight on the front lines or to be eaten by her. He happened to be seated next to Crokas and Erro Mordaurum, as well as Celeste and her frightened children. Coswald told Marlath, another frightened dragonborn, to keep his fear to himself, and attempted to comfort the children by telling them he'd been in scarier situations before this. He agreed with Erro when he was told they might get one opportunity, and to make it count. When Rei'nia Saph arrived with a convincing story that Crokas was contagious, Coswald concocted a convincing lie that he'd lunged for the children and had spit all over them. He was part of the group taken to the prison's oubliette in order to minimize the risk of illness being spread, and was grateful to Erro for having a friend buy them some extra time to live.
